description: A blunt windowless slab of soundstage, KSAB's call letters bolted twelve feet tall across the crete in channel-lit violet — one letter's ballast is dead, so it buzzes KS·B to anyone counting. A quilted loading roll-door stands dented beside the personnel entrance; a box-office window is cut into the crete beside it, lit from below, with a hand-lettered card taped inside the glass: TICKETS HERE — PAGES GO NORTH TO THE WRITERS' WING. A red ON AIR bulb over the door glows whether or not a soul is inside.
name: KSAB-TV Studio Stage
